notes.title: Feedback implemented and bugfixes!
notes.content:
Hey ho everybody!!

We just updated the game! The bugs you reported are now fixed! We also changed a few things on the levels and UI, here are some highlights:
- New option on pause menu to get back to the last checkpoint.
- New warning explaining that the game autosaves on the checkpoints.
- Start the game with a few non-blocking popups explaining the keys (for those playing on keyboard).
- Blocking key configuration of skills the player didn't unlocked yet!
- Bugfix: Can't move while the screen is loading.
- Bugfix: A few bushes of the game were getting stuck on Aiyra's head with a very few players (now it isn't)!
- Bugfix: Time counter stops right after you hit the last punch on the boss!

We hope you guys like the updates!

Remember to follow us on the social media and give us feedback through our email team@sensengames.com! :)

notes.title: Launch Challenge with Prize!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37052497/73da6b04e54bc45378974f4cd481dbe5cdcf8649.png[/img]

Our game was made to be hard, so don't expect easy job on this challenge, only the best on platforming games will be able to do it! You were warned! :)

The challenge is simple! Unlock 26 out of our 35 achievements until the end of the launch week and get our next game for free!

There's a lot of different achievements, some are easy, but you will get to unlock some hard achievements also hehe
After unlocking the achievements you just need to get your save file on [i]{game-dir}/saves/*.dat[/i] and send it to the email team@sensengames.com!

The first 20 players who send the email before the end of September, 17th will get our next release for free on its launch date!

Good Luck!!!

notes.title: Play Smashing Spirits Now!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37052497/1cf8f6dd159e0dff032587df7a1d82834bbadeb9.png[/img]

We (Hugo and Igor Roque) are proud to announce that Smashing Spirits is finally available! We love hard action platformers since we were kids and now we are releasing a game with those nostalgic feelings in it, a game with a unique combat mechanic and universe (maybe a bit crazy hehe).

Thanks for everybody that were following us until now, we hope you guys enjoy the end result, it was developed with care! :)

Any feedback, ideas, or suggestions just send us an email: team@sensengames.com!

Also follow us on social media:
[url=https://fb.com/sensengames]https://fb.com/sensengames[/url]
[url=https://instagram.com/sensengames]https://instagram.com/sensengames[/url]
